origin.label: From the RIZO archive
origin.heading: Before it was worn.
origin.teaser: The bone lettering started with a drawing by Taymar Spencer. A piece of the process, kept here.
origin.body: Bones shaped into letters. A skull for the O. This photograph shows the original RIZO artwork open in Photoshop, still inside the working file.
origin.body_second: Drawn by Taymar Spencer, the lettering became part of RIZO’s Skeleton pieces. The photograph is preserved here as a small record of the work behind the clothes.
origin.caption: BONE.psd / Original process photograph
